name: When should I start planning for a 1031 exchange for a luxury property?

mainEntity.name: When should I start planning for a 1031 exchange for a luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should start planning for a 1031 exchange for a luxury property well before listing your relinquished property for sale. This pre-planning allows you to assemble your team, including a qualified intermediary, tax advisor, and real estate specialist, like Kelby Contreras. Early preparation helps in understanding market conditions for potential replacement properties, especially in competitive luxury markets like Sunny Isles Beach or Fisher Island, and ensures you have a clear strategy for the identification and acquisition phases. Proactive planning helps mitigate the pressure of the strict 45-day and 180-day deadlines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start planning for a 1031 exchange for a luxury property well before listing your current property to allow ample time for team assembly and strategy.
